results.title: Social Justice Education in America - National Association of Scholars
results.content: San Francisco State University’s web of social justice advocacy illustrates how the nationwide movement to subsume higher education to the pursuit of progressive political activism operates in one institution. Social justice advocates have taken over much of university administration, particularly those offices devoted to the “co-curriculum.” They have also taken over the education of higher education administrators, and their professional organizations, and redefined their professional goals as the advancement of social justice. **San Francisco State University is a model for how social justice advocates are taking over American higher education.**.
